# Statistics on earnings and labour income

Earnings and income statistics capture how pay and labour income are distributed across workers and economies — including how unequally. ILOSTAT presents data on earnings levels, wage inequality, low pay, gender pay gaps, and labour income shares, supporting analysis of pay structures and income inequality in labour markets.

## Methods

 October 1, 1973 

Adopted by the 12th ICLS (1973), this resolution revises, broadens and integrates the prior standards in order to provide guidelines for the production of comprehensive and mutually consistent statistics of wages (including salaries) and the need to co-ordinate these statistics with other economic and social statistics.
